Use case: stylized-concept. Keep each object separate, no overlap. Genuine alpha transparent background, no floor plate or room, no rectangles, no checkerboard, no text, no numbers, no logos, no crown, no people. Output a landscape 3:2 sheet with exactly six chairs in clean 3x2 grid for deterministic extraction. These are fixed offline assets for the Angrier Jordan event, never generated at runtime.

processing: Deterministic rectangular sprite extraction, resizing and encoding; original alpha preserved. Source artwork is retained.
